blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Defense Secretary Gilbert Teodoro Jr. on Tuesday said funds allegedly received by a company associated with Vice President Sara Duterte and her husband from China-linked businesses could have national security implications. “Kung mapapatunayan talaga ‘to at ito ay may prima facie evidence na sinabi na nga ng AMLC (Anti-Money Laundering Council), kailangan talagang pagtuunan ng malalim na pansin ito,” Teodoro told reporters when asked about the severity of the issue after his visit to soldiers wounded in Basilan ambush. (If this can truly be proven—and there is indeed prima facie evidence, as stated by the Anti-Money Laundering Council—then […]...
